programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Mel Lewis, James Powell, William Powell & Glenn Drewes
programme.sub-title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era. They were an unusual band, creating new styles, succeeding in an era when big bands were unpopular and remaining integrated during racially tense periods.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Jacques Bailly, Willy Donni, Bruno Castellucci & José Bedeur
programme.sub-title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax' took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival. The second highlight of the festival is a trio of Belgian pianist François Boland, who appeared with American bassist Jimmy Woode and Belgian drummer Freddy Rottier. They are joined by four international guest saxophonists: German tenorist Klaus Doldinger, Belgian altoist Jacques Pelzer, British altoist Derek Humble, and Austrian saxophonist Karl Drewo. Following individual solo features and a joint encore, a true saxophone legend appears on stage: veteran American tenorist Coleman Hawkins. Accompanied by his compatriots Jimmy Woode (bass) and “Kansas” Fields (drums) and French pianist George Arvanitas, Coleman Hawkins plays an hour-long concert that includes "Disorder At The Border", "Autumn Leaves", "Lover Come Back To Me", "Moonlight In Vermont", "All The Things You Are" and “Ow!”. This concert is the perfect conclusion of the first jazz festival in honor of Adolphe Sax.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita'. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece's duration is longer than the composer's other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: The Bombing
programme.desc: Inspired by the heroic, untold true story of Chongqing. Starring legends Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Adrien Brody (The Pianist), this pulse-pounding war epic centres around the courage of Chinas citizens during WWII. As U.S. Air Force commander Jack Johnson trains the Chinese aviators to battle Japanese fighters, a hot-headed pilot begs to fly a powerful bomber that could stop the attacks.

programme.title: Chichinette: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: One womans extraordinary journey! This shocking true story puts espionage, secret intelligence and sheer determination at centre stage. After the 1944 liberation of Paris, a Jewish nurse is enlisted by the French Secret Service and sent to Germany. After failed attempts, she finally crosses the border but to stay undercover she must assimilate with the enemy to defeat the Nazis.

programme.title: Adventurer: The Curse of the Midas Box
programme.desc: Transporting you to a rollicking, rambunctious realm of enchanting fantasy, featuring Sam Neill (Jurassic Park) and Lena Headey (Game of Thrones). When Mariah's younger brother is kidnapped, he follows a trail of clues to discover a hidden realm of child-stealing monsters, ancient secrets and a long-lost artefact. Will our fearless hero save the fate of the world from evil? A magical must see!

programme.title: The Beat Beneath my Feet
programme.desc: With a School of Rock-esque vibe, this hilarious coming-of-age tale explores unconventional friendship in the most riotous way. When nerdy teen Tom meets rebellious American rock legend Max (Luke Perry), he knows this is his chance to fulfil his dreams. Tom agrees not to report the 'presumed dead' Max to the authorities...on the basis that he teaches him how to play guitar.

programme.title: Love and Honor
programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

programme.title: Ruth & Alex
programme.desc: When Ruth and Alex opt to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new apartment is not about winding down...

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: Between The Lights
programme.desc: When skeptical scientist Alice falls for reluctant medium Jay, she's taken on an odyssey of love, loss and discovery that will turn her world upside down.

programme.title: The Baker's Son
programme.desc: The locals of Windwards Island always knows when talented baker Matt has fallen in love, his loaves taste delicious. So, when his bread stops tasting bland, is it due to the newcomer or friend Annie?

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: (2023) Showstopper romance with Ansley Gordon and Christian Howard. There's no room for soggy bottoms as two rivals compete to bake a cake fit for a King. But who will be crowned royal star baker?

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: (2023) Flavourful romance starring Laura Miyata and David Lafontaine. An NYC baker would love to land a cookbook deal. Will a dash of royalty and a spoonful of romance help fulfil her dream?

programme.title: Wedding Cake Dreams
programme.desc: Carrie is convinced that the best man at her sister's wedding is her partner, as he resembles the man that appeared in her dream. Starring Donna Benedicto (2021)

programme.title: The Way To The Heart
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Meghan Heffern. When a big-city chef loses her spark, her boss insists she takes a break to find herself again. Will a visit to her hometown help her rediscover her passions?

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Senna, a struggling designer who hasn't quite found herself has given up on finding her soulmate. Despite attempts, by her best friend, to get her to settle down and pursue her passion of fashion, Senna continues down a path of irresponsible behaviour, lost jobs, and casual hook-ups with younger men

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: Unjustly fired by a spoilt and selfish yacht owner, Kate gets payback when he falls overboard and wakes up with amnesia...

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: A struggling TV chef returns home to find that her family's restaurant is for sale, not able to compete with contemporary cuisine. Trying to save it, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart and finds the inspiration she was seeking.

programme.title: 2 Years of Love
programme.desc: Samantha has a great marriage, until the pressure to have a baby comes up. Things get tricky when she starts falling for one of her clients, not realizing it is secretly her husband. Will they be able to make it through this rough patch?

programme.title: One Last Dance
programme.desc: In the wake of tragedy, a renowned NY dance company is on the brink of collapse. After leaving the dance world for good, Travis, Chrissa and Max have one last chance to re-connect with the passion and prove that miracles really can happen.

programme.title: Simply Irresistible
programme.desc: Magic and laughter are the main ingredients in this SIMPLY IRRESISTIBLE love story of a restaurant owner/chef and a department store executive who seem to have nothing in common.

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: A small-town coffee shop owner's romance with a struggling playwright from New York is threatened when her shop goes into foreclosure and her ex-boyfriend returns to town to save it.

programme.title: Finding Love In Sisters
programme.desc: When her mother dies, Esperanza returns to Sisters, Oregon and reunites with her sisters.

programme.title: It's a Fixer Upper
programme.desc: When The Dovers find they're in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne's parent's left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

programme.title: Belle and the Beast
programme.desc: Eric Landry is a cold-hearted man that people have nicknamed "the Beast." Years of anger and bitterness have consumed him, turning him into a selfish man. But Belle Watson is the exact opposite. When her father accidentally breaks a valuable work of art at the Landry mansion, Belles agrees to work for Eric in an effort to repay him and save her father's job. She discovers there just might be more to Eric. Will she find the man within the Beast?

programme.title: How to Train Your Husband
programme.desc: A marriage counselor attempts to fix her own marriage by focusing on how to change her husband.

programme.title: Secrets in the Desert
programme.desc: Charlie and her boyfriend Aidan break down in the middle of nowhere.

programme.title: Shattered Families
programme.desc: Heartbreaking accounts of families torn apart by crime.

programme.title: Trapped in the Farmhouse
programme.desc: A woman on the run from her abusive boyfriend seeks shelter in a farmhouse.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets by The Lake
programme.desc: Original idea by LMN & Harlequin uncovers Thornwood Heights' murder secrets.

programme.title: Disappearance in Yellowstone
programme.desc: Her daughter has been kidnapped and the police think that Jessie is responsible.

programme.title: Deadly Vows
programme.desc: Pastry chef Helena poisons men who don't meet her standards, but Helena's fiancé's sister smells danger.

programme.title: Fatal Defense
programme.desc: A single mother signs up for self-defense classes from a handsome instructor. But he develops a frightening obsession with her and orchestrates an increasing deadly array of "tests" to see if she has truly learned from his lessons.

programme.title: Deadly Patient
programme.desc: A patient mistakes his doctor's compassion for adoration and becomes dangerously obsessed.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and be Married
programme.desc: Billie helps save a wedding—and maybe finds love herself—in this charming romantic twist!

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: The all-star comedy cast from "Grown Ups" returns with some exciting new additions!

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: After moving to a small town, Zach Cooper finds a silver lining when he meets next door neighbor Hannah, the daughter of bestselling Goosebumps series author R.L. Stine. Stine is very mysterious and a prisoner of his own imagination – the monsters that his books made famous are real, and he protects his readers by keeping them locked up in their manuscripts. When the monsters are accidentally unleashed and begin to terrorize the town, it's up to Stine, Zach and Hannah to get them back in their books where they belong.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Halloween comes to life in a comedy adventure based on R.L. Stine's 400-million-selling series of books.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: From the guys who brought you PAUL BLART: MALL COP, five high school pals reunite after 30 years at a July 4th celebration and wrestle with the challenges of adulthood.

programme.title: Super Fuzz
programme.desc: Stricken by radiation, an agent acquires superpowers with which he breaks up a gang of counterfeiters who print bills on a fishing boat that he disposes of along with frozen fish. Among the superpowers are bullets stopped with his teeth.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year's Eve after a bout of fateful events.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

programme.title: The Plunderers
programme.desc: Cavalry officer John Drum attempts to track down outlaw Whit Lacey, but finds he must join forces with Lacey to fight a Sioux war party.

programme.title: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
programme.desc: In Tuscola, New Mexico, the Governor offers amnesty papers to all outlaws but gunfighter Clay McCord's appearance triggers a violent confrontation between the local marshal, McCord, and other outlaws

programme.title: Gunman of One Hundred Crosses
programme.desc: An Irishman is killed in the wild West. His son Jimmy goes out searching for the killers of his father, but is soon ambushed by two highwaymen, and killed, too.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: Montanans Jim Redfern and Mike Evans head into Canada's British Columbia via the Cariboo Trail intent to raise cattle and dig for gold but find trouble instead.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Multi award-winning film of the classic Shakespeare a play within a play'.

programme.title: The Spanish Gardener
programme.desc: Separated from his wife, Harrington Brande is posted to a small port in Spain

programme.title: Vote for Huggett
programme.desc: Comedy film of Huggett's plans to make a lido as a war memorial.

programme.title: No Place for Jennifer
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Jennifer becomes increasingly neurotic and is sent to a center for maladjusted children.

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Devil Doll
programme.desc: A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.

programme.title: Incognito
programme.desc: Retrieving a mythical lancet, Sydney and Nigel run into Nigel's look-alike just before his death. Nigel gets a cut from the lancet. Later, Cate persuades Nigel to impersonate the man.

programme.title: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, a collector, uses an ancient necklace to get Sydney to help her in raising Athena who will then help her conquer the world.

programme.title: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: When Sydney's student Meg's roommate finds a witch's amulet, it hospitalizes Meg. Meg's boyfriend's fraternity brother races to get the amulet. What is he up to?

programme.title: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: While Sydney is lecturing about the Native Americans who faced a mysterious cataclysm 600 years earlier, a native brings her a relic from that era. What is its secret?

programme.title: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: An urn commissioned in a Cambodian monastery by the Chinese emperor for the remains of Confucius is about to be destroyed by systematic bombing of a whole province.

programme.title: Warriors' Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Aspiring storm-chaser William is determined to continue his father's legacy by chasing the most dangerous supercell tornado ever seen.

programme.title: The Legend Of Hercules
programme.desc: In the epic origin story the legend of Hercules, a half-god, half-man blessed with extraordinary streng. Betrayed by his stepfather, the king, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Director Simon West and Nicolas Cage team-up for the first time since the 1997 blockbuster CON AIR for STOLEN, a unique fast paced action thriller that takes place during 10 frantic hours on Mardi Gras day in New Orleans.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: From the pages of Marvel Comics — creators of X-Men and Spider-Man — comes ELEKTRA, the first action-event movie of the year. In the ultimate battle between good and evil stands a warrior who makes the choice that tips the balance.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: In this made-for-TV movie, two brothers who battled on opposing sides of the Civil War return home at the end of the war to discover that their family has been kidnapped by Confederate forces.

programme.title: Dragon Wars
programme.desc: Meet Buraki, the vicious, 200-meter long Imoogi serpent from ancient Korea. His army includes giant lizards with missile launchers, flying dragons, soldiers bred for evil and mega-intelligent dinosaurs. Together, they will destroy Los Angeles and possibly the world unless reincarnated warriors Ethan and Sarah can outrun them and resurrect the Good Imoogi, Buraki's ancient nemesis.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: When the human race is on the verge of extinction, one of the last survivors on earth, an extraordinary young woman, goes on a mission to track down her younger brother who was abducted by the extra-terrestial creatures colonizing earth.

programme.title: No Good Deed
programme.desc: A thriller centered on a one-time district attorney who is kidnapped along with her two children.

programme.title: Money Monster
programme.desc: Lee Gates, a bombastic television stock huckster, is taken hostage on his TV show by an outraged gunman. As much of the world watches live, Gates must keep himself alive and, with help from the woman who produces the show, uncover the truth behind a tangle of big money lies.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke delivers one of his strongest performances as Johnny Walker, a washed-up boxer looking for one more shot in the ring.

programme.title: The Crush [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Fever Pitch [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A sports fan's romantic courtship clashes with his obsession with his favorite football team. Based on the book by Nick Hornby.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: Ce qu'Alice ne vous dit pas

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca
programme.sub-title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer's band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins' band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers
programme.sub-title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Mel Lewis, James Powell, William Powell & Glenn Drewes
programme.sub-title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era. They were an unusual band, creating new styles, succeeding in an era when big bands were unpopular and remaining integrated during racially tense periods.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Jacques Bailly, Willy Donni, Bruno Castellucci & José Bedeur
programme.sub-title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax' took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival. The second highlight of the festival is a trio of Belgian pianist François Boland, who appeared with American bassist Jimmy Woode and Belgian drummer Freddy Rottier. They are joined by four international guest saxophonists: German tenorist Klaus Doldinger, Belgian altoist Jacques Pelzer, British altoist Derek Humble, and Austrian saxophonist Karl Drewo. Following individual solo features and a joint encore, a true saxophone legend appears on stage: veteran American tenorist Coleman Hawkins. Accompanied by his compatriots Jimmy Woode (bass) and “Kansas” Fields (drums) and French pianist George Arvanitas, Coleman Hawkins plays an hour-long concert that includes "Disorder At The Border", "Autumn Leaves", "Lover Come Back To Me", "Moonlight In Vermont", "All The Things You Are" and “Ow!”. This concert is the perfect conclusion of the first jazz festival in honor of Adolphe Sax.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita'. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece's duration is longer than the composer's other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Céline Dion
programme.sub-title: Celine Dion - Taking Chances World Tour
programme.desc: Part of the world tour of Celine Dion, which was seen by more than 3 million people and covered 5 continents, 25 countries and 92 cities - the first tour in nine years that was an absolute success. Enjoy the biggest hits of the decade's most important artist: "Because You Loved Me", "All By Myself", "My Heart Will Go On", "I Drove All Night" and others!

programme.title: Adele
programme.desc: Fans at the iTunes Festival: London 2011 were blown away with the performance of English singer-songwriter Adele. This concert was recorded live on stage at The Roundhouse in London, United Kingdom, where Adele gave one of the best shows of her career with her unique voice.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

La casa ha sido ocupada por otra familia que les exige con violencia inusitada el agua y los alimentos. Tras el enfrentamiento, los asaltantes obligan a Anna y a sus hijos a huir. Estos se dirigen al pueblo más cercano en busca de refugio y alimentos. Pero, tras la hecatombe a la que se refieren algunas emisoras de radio, la comida y el agua se han convertido en un bien escaso que nadie está dispuesto a compartir.

Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

Una chica tiene la oportunidad de revivir 7 veces su último día de vida para desvelar el misterio que rodea su muerte.

programme.desc: Un novelista ciego tras un accidente de coche en el que también falleció su mujer, redescubre su pasión perdida por la vida y la escritura cuando comienza un romance con la mujer de un hombre de negocios condenado.

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: La vida de Rachel se complica cuando acaba celebrando su treinta cumpleaños acostándose con el prometido de su mejor amiga. Divertida comedia romántica protagonizada por Kate Hudson

programme.title: Sueños de juventud
programme.desc: El profesor jubilado Josef acepta un modesto trabajo, recogiendo envases retornables en un supermercado, para huir de la monotonía en la que vive con su mujer Eliska. Allí, pronto se convierte en un celestino, que empareja a sus solitarios colegas con clientas solteras y viceversa. Mientras Josef intenta arreglar una nueva relación, Eliska se pregunta por qué su marido no pasa más tiempo con ella.

programme.title: Le Week-End
programme.desc: Nick y Meg, una pareja de maduros profesores británicos con los hijos ya independizados, deciden regresar a la romántica París muchos años después de su luna de miel, con motivo de su trigésimo aniversario, para intentar revitalizar su matrimonio.

programme.title: El mejor regalo
programme.desc: Senna es una aspirante a diseñadora de moda que aún no se ha encontrado a sí misma y que ha renunciado a encontrar a su alma gemela. A pesar de los intentos de su mejor amiga y madre de lograr que se establezca, Senna continúa por un camino de trabajos perdidos y encuentros casuales con hombres más jóvenes. Todo parece estar fuera de control hasta que conoce a Adam, un apuesto abogado.

programme.title: Disparando a perros
programme.desc: Un párroco católico y un joven idealista se ven envueltos en el genocidio de Ruanda de 1994. Ante la dramática situación deben decidir si permanecen con los miles de Tutsis a punto de ser masacrados o huir hacia la libertad. Los cascos azules de la ONU, impotentes por el mandato de no intervención, solo pudieron disparar a los perros que devoraban los cadáveres de las víctimas.

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Secuestro se complica cuando el esposo no paga.

programme.title: Una nueva vida
programme.desc: Tras perder a su esposa, Bill y su hijo comienzan de nuevo en California con ayuda de dos mujeres.

programme.title: V.O.S
programme.desc: Un juego entre dos parejas, entre cuatro personajes. Cuatro visiones de una misma historia.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: El Furgón
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un accidente de tráfico, tres delincuentes escapan del furgón policial.

programme.title: La hermana del novio
programme.desc: Audrey cumplirá 40 años y su hermano se casará con una chica que conoció en Francia. Antes de la boda se revela un secreto, Audrey y la joven prometida no se llevan bien.

programme.title: In the Loop
programme.desc: El Presidente de EE.UU. y el Primer Ministro británico deciden iniciar una guerra y prometen ser rápidos. El Secretario de Estado británico para el desarrollo internacional, respalda accidentalmente la acción militar en horario de máxima audiencia en televisión, ganando muchos amigos en Washington.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo, han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Pinball: el hombre que salvó el juego
programme.desc: La historia de Roger Sharpe, el joven del Medio Oeste que revocó la prohibición de las máquinas de pinball en la ciudad de Nueva York, que llevaba 35 años vigente.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Superpoli En Las Vegas
programme.desc: Kevin James vuelve a interpretar a Paul Blart, un guardia de seguridad. Blart va a Las Vegas para supervisar una Exposición y aprovecha la ocasión para llevarse a su hija Maya (Raini Rodriguez), que pronto se irá a estudiar fuera. Paul descubre con sorpresa que se está produciendo un atraco, así que tendrá que detener a los criminales.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Deeds (Adam Sandler) es un ingenuo provinciano que vive en un pueblo de New Hampshire. Como propietario de "Deeds' Pizza", la única pizzeria del pueblo, se ha hecho muy popular por su particular manera de entretener a los clientes recitándoles sus insólitos poemas. La vida transcurre plácidamente hasta que recibe la noticia de que un pariente lejano le ha dejado una herencia de cuarenta billones de dólares, una cadena de medios de comunicación, un equipo de fútbol, un equipo de baloncesto y un helicóptero privado.

programme.title: El Tesoro De Curly
programme.desc: En esta secuela del gran éxito de taquilla, el neoyorquino Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) y su hermano Glen (Jon Lovitz), la oveja negra de la familia, encuentran por accidente un antiguo mapa del tesoro oculto en la cinta del sombrero del difunto Curly. Después de visitar la biblioteca local, descubren que el padre de Curly participó en un célebre robo a un tren.

programme.title: Perseguido
programme.desc: Huérfano tras el asesinato de su familia, Jeb es criado en un rancho, pero su pasado lo persigue. Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Los ángeles vengadores
programme.desc: Miles Utley, un guardaespaldas mormón, se ve forzado a cuestionar sus creencias cuando investiga un caso de asesinato y corrupción inmobiliaria. Su búsqueda de la verdad lo empuja a romper con su comunidad y a enfrentarse a oscuros secretos.

programme.title: Al oeste de la división
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters de Gentry y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace tiempo.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: La quebrada del diablo
programme.desc: Al capitán Viktor Kaleb, desertor del ejército, se le ofrece el indulto y la reincorporación a la caballería si acepta liderar un grupo de fuerzas especiales en una incursión contra un bastión apache en México.

programme.title: Proscrito
programme.desc: Una historia llena de acción, corrupción y asesinatos. En inferioridad numérica, superado en armamento y contra todo pronóstico, un comando se abre paso a través de un asedio para salvar a su chica.

programme.title: Muerto por Carol
programme.desc: Carol se muda con su padre y abuelo al tranquilo pueblo de Zapote, donde experimenta la intensidad del primer amor junto a Rito. Entre descubrimientos, emociones y el despertar de nuevos sentimientos, su vida cambia para siempre en esta historia íntima y entrañable.

programme.title: Llamarada solar
programme.desc: Un joven descubre una enorme tormenta solar a punto de destruir la red eléctrica de la Tierra y debe alertar al mundo antes de que un poderoso empresario lo detenga.

programme.title: Noches sin lunas ni soles
programme.desc: El Cairo ha pasado tres años en prisión. Cuatro meses antes de cumplir su condena, se fuga. El sheriff Maidana intenta recapturarlo.

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Regan (Elle Fanning) es una adolescente de Nueva York que decide operarse para cambiar de sexo. Junto a su madre, Maggie (Naomi Watts), viven en casa de su abuela, Dolly (Susan Sarandon), una manager de música que comparte piso con su novia. Maggie tiene que enfrentarse al padre de Regan para que firme también los permisos de la operación y deberá asumir que tiene que criar a su única hija como un hijo.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: Arturo y Merlin: Los caballeros de Camelot
programme.desc: El Rey Arturo, mucho más viejo que cuando partió por primera vez, regresa a casa tras combatir al Imperio Romano. Su hijo ilegítimo ha corrompido el trono de Camelot, por lo que Arturo tendrá que reunirse con el mago Merlín y los Caballeros de la Mesa redonda para recuperar su corona.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: Todos están muertos
programme.desc: Viendo a Lupe encerrada en casa, en bata y zapatillas, nadie diría que en los 80 fue una estrella del rock. La agorafobia no le permite salir de casa, y su madre, Paquita, se ocupa de ella y de su nieto adolescente. Pero a Paquita se le acaba el tiempo y no quiere marcharse sin recuperar a su hija.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Bajo un manto de estrellas
programme.desc: En 1936, el vetusto convento de Calatrava era la sede de la casa de estudios mayores, el noviciado y la escuela apostólica de humanidades de los dominicos.

programme.title: Quién eres
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de María, una joven que busca formar parte de un grupo y que es bastante ingenua. Después de una gran discusión con su amiga Clara, decide pasar el rato hablando con Lucas, un hombre que ha conocido a través de internet y del que sabe más bien poco.

programme.title: Inconcievable
programme.desc: Inconceivable tells the story of two adventurous women in love, and desperate to have their own biological children. They embark on an experimental scientific process which creates sperm from their own stem cells. Chock full of humor and unexpected twists, their journey ultimately shows them that life is a gift and all families are crazy.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: Un diseno mortal
programme.desc: Aurora esta emocionada porque su amiga Poppy se ha mudado a la ciudad. Pero cuando la joven es hallada muerta, Aurora decide investigar lo sucedido.

programme.title: Killbillies
programme.desc: Deformed, depraved hillbillies capture models and crew of a photo shoot. Will they all die a horrible death or fight off the attackers?

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso desconocido llega a un hospital local al borde de la muerte, un interrogatorio del FBI desvela un complot internacional de venganza.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: Infalible
programme.desc: Kevin, Rob y Sam son miembros de un grupo que, sólo en teoría, planea asaltos perfectos, como hobby, sin la menor intención de llevarlos a cabo. Un gángster encuentra parte de su material de trabajo y decide chantajearlos para que realicen un robo millonario.

programme.title: Santos y soldados: Objetivo Berlín
programme.desc: El 15 de agosto de 1944, el equipo de combate del regimiento de paracaidistas llega al sur de Francia en una misión para apoyar a las tropas aliadas en su camino a Berlín. En su misión de guerra se encuentran con un grupo de franceses que necesitan ayuda, poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la misión.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que ofrece acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan.

programme.title: Infalible
programme.desc: Teóricos de atracos son chantajeados por un gángster para ejecutar un golpe real millonario y sobrevivir.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Agente de la DEA con TEPT vuelve tras fracasar y protege a su familia de un convicto y sus secuaces.

programme.title: Geo-Disaster
programme.desc: Una familia se encuentra separada durante la convergencia de las mayores catástrofes de la historia.

programme.title: El ejecutor
programme.desc: Kyle fue criado por un corrupto sacerdote que lo entrenó para hacer el mal.

programme.title: Total Recall (Desafío Total)
programme.desc: Mientras las naciones de Euroamérica y Nueva Shanghái rivalizan por conseguir la supremacía, Doug Quaid es un obrero que sospecha que es espía pero que no sabe para qué lado trabaja.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: Un aterrizaje de emergencia deja tirados a Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) y a su legendario padre Cypher (Will Smith) en la Tierra, 1000 años después de que el cataclismo obligara a la humanidad a escapar de ahí.

programme.title: Anaconda 4: Rastro De Sangre
programme.desc: Una cría de anaconda, genéticamente mejorada, se ha regenerado y crece monstruosamente. La cría sedienta de sangre es aparentemente invencible, y se desliza entre explosiones y disparos para regenerarse y alimentarse insaciablemente de todo lo que se encuentre en su camino.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: La Amenaza
programme.desc: En un centro de investigación en un bosque europeo, un brillante científico está realizando esperimentos con dos colosales serpientes. Pero cuando el hombre de negocios que financia todo, lleva el experimento demasiado lejos, las serpientes escapan, hambrientas y dirigiéndose hacia la civilización.
